armySpecialRules.name: BATTLE CRY
armySpecialRules.description: All friendly unit joined by a model with this special rule may add D3" to their charge distance.

armySpecialRules.name: WAR FURY
armySpecialRules.description: All models with this special rule re-roll 1's on their charge distances. In addition, whenever they declare a charge or pursue a fleeing enemy, the models gain the Hatred special for the duration of the turn.

armySpecialRules.name: TRIBAL AFFILIATION
armySpecialRules.description:
Your army may be associated with one of the Tribes below. Having a Clan Affiliation will allow your army to use special abilities on the battlefield that reflects their famous Tribe. Certain units in your army may have a Tribal Affiliation, as detailed in the army list. However, you may not have multiple Tribal Affiliations in the same army.
• Falian: Infantry models with this special rule may deploy as Ambushers, and get +1 To Hit in close combat when attacking enemies in their flank or rear.
• Finian: Models with this special rule have the Cold- Blooded special rule when taking Panic and Break tests.
• Fir Domain: Models with this special rule gain +1 armour save when using shields.
• Sessair: Models with this special rule re-roll 1's when rolling To Wound in close combat.

magicItems.name: THE LIGHTNING SPEAR
magicItems.description: All close combat and missile attacks with this weapon automatically Hit and have the Lightning Attacks special rule. Any Hits from Shooting penetrates ranks as if it were a Bolt Thrower.

magicItems.name: THE BARBED SPEAR
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength and the Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE GREAT STAFF
magicItems.description: For every unsaved Wound caused by this weapon in close combat, you may restore 1 Wounds worth of models in the same unit previously slain during the battle just like a summoning spell.

magicItems.name: THE ANSWERER
magicItems.description: This sword has the Ignore Armour Saves special rule, and for every Wound caused, the enemy model must pass a Toughness test or suffer an additional Wound.

magicItems.name: THE SINGING SWORD
magicItems.description: In any turn in which the wielder causes one or more unsaved Wound with this sword, all enemy units within 12" must immediately take and resolve a Panic Test.

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF FIACHA
magicItems.description: The wielder gains Magic Resistance (2). If a spell is dispelled with the assistance of this item, the Wizard who cast it forgets that spell on the roll of a 4+.

magicItems.name: WHITE HILT
magicItems.description: The wielder of this sword gains Flaming Attacks. Against models with Toughness 5 or more, he may re-roll failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: YSBADDADAN'S JAVELINS
magicItems.description: These weapons have the Multiple Wounds (D3) and Poisoned Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: SICKLE SWORDS OF HORDEK
magicItems.description: On any to hit roll of 5+, the weapon automatically wounds.

magicItems.name: OGHAM ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer gains a Magical Ward (5+) and may re-roll Ward save results of 1.

magicItems.name: THE EAR OF BEAUTY
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Parry (5+) special rule. For every successful Parry save the wielder makes in close combat, he may make an extra attack back immediately against the model/unit that struck the blow.

magicItems.name: MOOR ARMOUR
magicItems.description: All attacks made against the bearer are resolved at -1 Strength.

magicItems.name: SWIFT TO HAND
magicItems.description: The bearer gains +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: HELM OF PRIDWEN
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, the wearer gains the Mighty Blow (1) special rule in any turn in which they make a successful charge.

magicItems.name: RED-BACKED
magicItems.description: This shield (but not any other armour the wearer might have) ignores all negative modifiers when taking armour saves.

magicItems.name: FIMIR-SKIN CLOAK
magicItems.description: The wearer of this item gains the Natural Armour (6+) special rule. However, all Fimir models gain the Hatred special rule against the wearer.

magicItems.name: THE TRISKELE
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Triskele gains the Magical Ward (5+) and Magic Resistance (2) special rules.

magicItems.name: RING OF ELUNED THE FORTUNATE
magicItems.description: The character cannot be targeted by any missile attack.

magicItems.name: BRACELET OF PURITY
magicItems.description: The wearer can take a Leadership test at the start of each turn. If passed, they are immediately granted a Magical Ward (4+) for the duration of the turn.

magicItems.name: HONOUR BELT OF CONSTITUTION
magicItems.description: The wearer gains +1 to their Toughness.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF LIGHT
magicItems.description: The bearer gains +1 dispel bonus and +1 to all channelling rolls for dispel dice.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF SUMMONING
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a casting bonus equal to the rank bonus of any unit they are in.

magicItems.name: MAGIC CATCHER
magicItems.description: Whenever an enemy spell (except summoning spells) is successfully cast within 12" of the bearer of this item, roll a D6. On a 4+, that spell can then be cast once as a Bound Spell as a power level equal to the spell's normal casting value in your next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: POTION OF KNOWLEDGE
magicItems.description: The potion can be used at the start of any of your Magic phases. Once used, the Wizard gains the Loremaster special rule from any one lore normally available to them for the duration of this Magic phase.

magicItems.name: OGHAM SHARD
magicItems.description: Any spell that is cast this turn will count the roll of any double (except 1's) as 6's for the purpose of rolling Ultimate Power.

magicItems.name: CAULDRON OF REBIRTH
magicItems.description: At the start of each of your Magic phases, you may restore up to D3 Wounds worth of models in the same unit previously slain during the battle, just like a summoning spell. Any friendly character slain in this unit may also be resurrected once in this manner. However, a resurrected character does not bestow his Leadership onto the unit, nor can the unit benefit from his War Cry ability. Resurrected Wizards can no longer cast spells.

magicItems.name: WHETSTONE OF TUDWAL TUDGLYD
magicItems.description: The bearer will automatically Wound with their Close Combat attacks.

magicItems.name: HORN OF BORABU
magicItems.description: One Infantry unit in your army may be given the Ambushers special rule. In addition, that unit may automatically enter the battlefield within 24" of the bearer of this item, instead of rolling to see if they arrive.

magicItems.name: ARDAGH CHALICE
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any of your turns. When used, the bearer gains +1 Strength, Toughness and Attacks until the start of your next turn.

magicItems.name: CHARIOT OF MORGAN MWYNFAWR
magicItems.description: The model's Chariot gains the Fly (7) special rule.

magicItems.name: CRANE-SKIN BAG OF CUMHAIL
magicItems.description: The wearer may choose between any one Magic Weapon from the Main Rulebook worth up to 15 points each turn. They may not take any other Magic Weapon.

magicItems.name: HARP OF DAGDA
magicItems.description: This item contains an augment aura spell with a range of 12". All fleeing units within range automatically Rally.

magicItems.name: RORY MOR'S HORN
magicItems.description: At the start of the battle, the bearer may attempt to drink from the Horn by passing a Strength test. If passed, they gain +1 to their Leadership for the remainder of the battle.

magicItems.name: MAD MARSH WADERS
magicItems.description: The wearer of these magical boots and any unit he joins gain the Swamp Strider special rule, and are always Steadfast when in a marsh.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE SUN KING
magicItems.description: All models in the unit will always Wound enemies on at least a 3+ in close combat. Armour saves are affected by the unit's normal Strength. In addition, the unit receives +D3 to its Combat Resolution bonus in any turn that they charge.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE ANCIENTS
magicItems.description: All friendly units of Half Giants, Giants, Bonegrinder Giants, Centaurs and Pixies gain a Magical Ward (6+) if they are within 12" of this banner.

magicItems.name: VIRIDIAN STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Flammable and Natural Armour (6+) special rules.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE MISTS
magicItems.description: Any missile fire directed against the unit carrying this standard suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: THE BOG STANDARD
magicItems.description: All models in any unit charging the unit carrying this standard must take a dangerous terrain test as though charging through a marsh.

magicItems.name: THE FAIRY FLAG OF DUNVEGAN
magicItems.description: All enemy units within 12" and with line of sight to the unit carrying this standard at the start of their turn must take a Psychology test. If failed, the unit must move straight towards them, following all the rules for Stupidity.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF FIONN MAC CUMHAILL
magicItems.description: The unit may re-roll failed rolls to Wound in the first round of Close Combat.
